summary_en: This phase 3 trial compares high dose chemotherapy followed by a transplant of the patient's own stem cells with observation only, in people with peripheral T-cell lymphoma who reached complete remission after first-line chemotherapy. Patients in the transplant arm first receive stem cell mobilization therapy and leukapheresis, then high dose chemotherapy and the stem cell transplant; how long or how often is not stated. The study measures survival, as stated in the trial title.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 3 compara la quimioterapia de dosis alta seguida de un trasplante de las propias células madre del paciente con solo observación, en personas con linfoma de células T periféricas que alcanzaron una remisión completa después de la quimioterapia inicial. Los pacientes del brazo de trasplante primero reciben terapia de movilización de células madre y leucoaféresis, y luego quimioterapia de dosis alta y el trasplante de células madre; la duración o la frecuencia no se indican. El estudio mide la supervivencia, según se indica en el título del ensayo.
who_for: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma of a listed type: ALK-negative anaplastic large cell, angioimmunoblastic, nodal follicular helper T-cell, or not otherwise specified.
Treated with anthracycline-based induction and in radiologic complete remission by PET-CT after induction.
Eligible for high dose chemotherapy and stem cell transplant under the enrolling center's guidelines.
not_for: Active infection needing intravenous antimicrobial treatment at randomization.
Absolute neutrophil count below 1000/mcL or platelets below 75,000/mcL.
Total bilirubin above 1.5 times the upper limit of normal, or AST/ALT above 3 times the upper limit of normal.
Childbearing potential without a pregnancy test or effective contraception as required.
cancer_types: peripheral t-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified
